The plan was operationalized through day-of-hospital navigation, report/medication-box verification, and repeated family read-backs. Multiple high-order opportunities were actively completed, especially verification of the “脑积水” report, recognition of levothyroxine/甲减 medication management, correction of unsafe self-turning ideas, and real-world scheduling/queue navigation.
